The cheerful girl whom Riku often played with as a child. When they meet again after Riku returns to Tsukigasaki, he’s surprised to see that her appearance hasn’t changed at all. She mysteriously appears and disappears on the bridge connecting the old district to the new district much like an illusion.
不思議な女の子。
陸のことを「りっくん」と呼んでは、無邪気に接してくる。
過去、陸とは冬の間だけ、月ヶ咲で一緒に遊んでいた。
そして三月になり、春に入ると必ず姿を消してしまう。
陸にとっては粉雪のように儚い存在で、大切な人だった。

A fellow Elfin who came to Tsukigasaki along with Riku and Hinata. She grew up in the same orphanage as Riku. She often tries to act older, to counteract her child-like appearance which very much bothers her. Despite her being the age where she should be going to school, she chooses to work at the kindergarten in Tsukigasaki.
She is Riku's half-sister.
陸と同じ組織に所属しているエルフィンで、共に月ヶ咲を訪れた。
表情はほとんど動かさず、話すときも淡々としている。
だが、慌てたときには言葉を噛むことも。
月校には通わず、月ヶ咲幼稚園（通称、月ヶ園）のお手伝いをしながら、園児である葉月を護衛することになる。周囲の園児からぺたんこ先生と呼ばれて慕われるが、本人はとても困っている。
陸の妹であり、同じ組織に所属しているエルフィン。
月ヶ咲での任務を終え、一度組織に帰還したが、新たな指令によって再び戻って来ることになった。
陸とは仕事上のパートナーから、兄妹関係、そして恋仲へと変わっていったが、胸がぺたんこなのは変わっていない。

Full name: Asaumi Korona (浅海 ころな)
Likes: Humans
Dislikes: Causing trouble

A robot produced by the Valhalla Institute with the hope of one day being sent into space to explore far-off planets. In order to become accustomed to human culture and becoming more similar to them, she attends Tsukikou. She is very friendly and speaks overly polite to everyone. She’s very enthusiastic about making friends with everyone to the point where she wants to know the names and faces of everyone who goes to Tsukikou. However, she’s afraid her being a robot scares people away from her. She often helps her friend Rui out at the local shrine.
She was actually born as a normal human girl and awakened as a very powerful Elfin and can use a multitude of runes. Her specialty is pyrokinesis.
月校の１年生。
見た目も振る舞いも人間にしか思えないが、実は街の研究所によって造られた人型ロボット。そのせいか、愛称はコロ助。
良い子で強い子、健気な性格と非の打ち所がないが、少し世間とズレている面もある。
失敗を繰り返しては、早く人間のようになりたいと願っている。
世界初のエルフィン宇宙飛行士、エルフィンノーツとして活躍する陸の恋人。
本名は、浅海ころな。
本人は早く陸と結婚して、幸せな家庭を築きたいと願っているが、そのためには宇宙飛行士を辞めることになる。
どんな進路を選ぶべきか、今はふたりで相談中。

Likes: Killing time
Dislikes: Things that she can't use to kill time

A girl in Hinata’s class whom Hinata immediately recognizes as a fellow Elfin. She’s part of the student council which somewhat allows to Hinata to become her friend. Not much is known about her including whether or not she belongs to an organization like Riku, Rinne, and Hinata do.
月校の２年生。陸とはクラスが分かれている。
成績は優秀、運動神経も抜群だが、彼女にとって学校の勉強は暇つぶし以上の価値を持たない。生徒会に所属しているのも、単に先生に頼まれたからで、何事にも関心がないように見える。
そんな彼女とは、任務中になぜかたびたび顔を合わせることになる。
陸と同じエルフィンなのだが、彼女の目的を知る者は陸の近くにはいない。
進級し、今は陸とともに月校の三年生になっている。
成績は優秀、運動神経も抜群だが、琴里にとって学校の勉強は暇つぶし以上の価値を持てなかった。
この価値観を変えてくれたのが友人の柚子であり、恋人の陸だった。
だが、陸に対してなかなか素直になれない琴里は、周囲からもっとデレるべきだと突っ込まれている。

Likes: Running (moving her body)
Dislikes: Staying on the same spot for a long time

A friend and classmate of Ochiba at Tsukikou. She’s an overly energetic and sociable person. She’s part of the school's track team and enjoys running to the extent that she’ll often take it on herself to practice in her free time by the riverbank under the bridge. She lives in the new district with her older sister Miharu who works as a researcher for the Valhalla Institute.
She awakens as an Elfin because she is worried about her sister's workaholic behavior. However later she loses her rune powers.
月校の２年生。陸のクラスメイトであり、落葉の友達。

いることも。

姉の美晴と同じ大学に進むため、今は陸と一緒に受験勉強の真っ直中。
だが机に向かうのが苦手なせいで、思うように進んでいない。
身体を動かすことが大好きで、故郷の鳳島に帰ったときは、よく自転車で走っている。

Likes: Her younger sister Hazuki
Dislikes: Sloppiness

The director’s daughter whom Riku, Hinata, and Rinne were sent to protect. She lives together with her younger sister in the old city. She does the housework and takes care of Hazuki, and does both with dedication. She’s a part of the student council, but rarely attends meetings due to being busy with housework and picking up Hazuki from kindergarten. Her father lives away from them and seems distanced from them due to his job, which may be why she dislikes him.
She is an Elfin who can use the rune empathy. Her powers were sealed away by the ring made by her father.
月ヶ咲学園（通称、月校）の２年生。
陸のクラスメイトであり、護衛対象。
妹の葉月と二人暮らしだったが、陸が居候することになる。
家では、家事全般を取り仕切っている。
陸に対しては少々きついところを見せるが、面倒見は良い。
学校では清楚な優等生として頼られており、生徒会にも所属している。
陸のクラスメイトであり、護衛対象。
今は進級し、月ヶ咲学園の三年生になっている。
家事スキルが抜群で、主婦力は他の追随を許さない。
陸に対してもお姉さんぶることが多いのだが、夜の営みではいつも立場が逆転してしまうのが悩みの種。

Dislikes: Living a life where others have to take care of her

Professor Shiraha's daughter and Riku's older sister. She has been bedridden for the majority of her life due to an illness. Many years ago she became the first Elfin in an event that gave birth to Yuuki.
陸の姉であり、世界で初めて生まれたエルフィン。
長い間、寝たきりだったため、車椅子生活を送っていた。
現在はリハビリのおかげで、少しずつ歩けるようになっている。
ある事情から陸とのふたり暮らしが決まったことで、弟の世話をたくさん焼こうと意気込んでいる。
陸の姉であり、世界で初めて生まれたエルフィン。長い間、寝たきりだったため、車椅子生活を送っていた。現在はリハビリのおかげで、少しずつ歩けるようになっている。ある事情から陸との二人暮らしが決まったことで、弟の世話をたくさん焼こうと意気込んでいる。

The other Elfin who came to Tsukigasaki with Rinne and Riku despite never having lived there in the past. She joins the student council right after transferring in to Tsukikou to the surprise of everyone else in the student council. Has a very apparent interest (sexual) in girls and is able to figure out a girl’s bust size simply by staring at them.

Ochiba's younger sister who is very polite and affectionate. She goes to Tsukigasaki’s Kindergarten with her friends Marimo and Shiina. After Riku finds her and pats her on the head she becomes attached to him, calling him Onii-chan.

She is an Elfin who can use the rune precognition. Her powers were sealed away by the ring made by her father, but she still uses her power subconsciously, especially if something bad is about to happen.

A shrine maiden from the Seitenguu. She's a friend of Corona’s who is in charge of the local shrine. She often sleeps in strange places and has a notoriously poor memory due to “burning them to stay warm”.
The president of the student council and Marimo's older sister. She often takes it upon herself to do most of the student council work, often refusing the help of the other members.

Yuzu's younger sister. She’s one of Hazuki’s friends at the kindergarten and a bit mischievous. She takes great pride in her older sister and will insist that she’s better than anyone else’s. Also enjoys getting on Riku and Rinne’s nerves by shouting at them and accusing them of various things, often resulting in them grinding their knuckles against her head as punishment and calling her names like acorn (due to her ponytail making her head look like one).

Sousuke's younger sister and one of Hazuki’s friends at the kindergarten who is very shy. She always carries around her stuffed animal with her wherever she goes. She greatly loves her Grandmother and won’t hesitate to repeat anything and everything that her Grandmother tells her, no matter how strange.
Lives at the shrine with Rui and is a swan (apparently).
Hazuki and Ochiba's Father.

The main character in AstralAir. Riku is an Elfin (people who can use psychic abilities) along with Hinata and Rinne, and is a part of the organization run by Ochiba’s father, Daiki. As a child, he lived in an orphanage in Tsukigasaki alongside Rinne. During that time he often played with a girl named Yuuki, making snowmen and having snowball fights. Years later, he returns again to Tsukigasaki to guard Ochiba and Hazuki, living in their house with them.
Valhalla Institute's leader.
Yuki and Riku's mother.
A teacher at Tsukigasaki’s Kindergarten who has a very good relationship with her students. She also serves as Rinne's mentor there.
She is a powerful Elfin working for Valhalla. Unlike most Elfin she specializes in two runes: psy-missing (which allows her to hide her identity to other Elfin) and hypno.
Shiina's older brother and one of Riku's classmates. He is part of the school's track team and used to be friends with Ochiba before.
Ichika's older sister who works for the Valhalla Institute as a researcher.
Former student council president.
